activation_ack_race.exclusion: A START failure without a valid accepted ACTIVATE receipt does not create a running handle.
activation_ack_race.observation: The subsequent wait observes the verified terminal summary and returns or raises according to COMPLETED, FAILED or CANCELLED. No new activation/fail mutation is issued.
activation_ack_race.rule: An exact ACTIVATE replay whose immutable receipt and activation_operation_id prove committed activation may return a RunningStreamGraph identity even when the volatile execution projection has already advanced through STOPPING to TERMINAL.

scope: No DTO, route, digest, ADR body, acceptance criterion, readiness or publication-status change.

task_event_dispatch.route: existing /streams/v2/subtasks/{subtask_id}/events and existing signed event DTO
task_event_dispatch.rule: Dispatch by persisted graph profile before the legacy fixed-P2 require_subtask lock path. DAG failure handling acquires Graph UPDATE before Task/Grant locks and validates exact current own scoped child authority/readiness. Fixed-P2 route bytes and behavior remain unchanged.
task_event_dispatch.surface: No additional public or child event route is added.

terminal_data_auth.exclusion: No parent Flow credentials gain DATA authority.
terminal_data_auth.rule: NI011 append/complete routes preserve the existing Flow-holder typed EXECUTION_PROFILE_NOT_READY refusal and exact legacy bytes, while NI2-012 DAG DATA dispatch accepts only the exact current own Subtask capability and grant.
